meta.notes: M1 starting numbers (docs/milestones/M1.md): 20 / 6 / 25 ticks, steal window ticks 7-20 of the wind-up. Damage, knockback and hit-stop are combat-2's [default] starting values: slower than a kick, hits harder. In M1 the sim lays one at each of three spots along the route (sim/combat PICKUP_ROUTE_FRACTIONS), uses are unlimited, and it always drops on a wreck.
